payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP on length and balance to count valid bracket prefix sequences, then enumerate split point and balances for p and q to combine with s into a valid full sequence.
payload.rationale: Solution builds a 2D DP table dp[i][j] (i=length, j=balance) for valid bracket sequences, then iterates over prefix length i and balance l, computing required suffix balance r to make total valid sequence, multiplying corresponding DP counts.
